body:
Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation (MRAG) has emerged as a reliable and cost-effective technique of grounding the generative capabilities of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) into relevant, up-to-date, external knowledge. Despite presenting several benefits, such as reducing hallucinatory behavior, they also introduce new attack surfaces, including leakage of private information and vulnerabilities against data extraction attacks.

In this paper, we introduce , an adaptive and automatic data extraction attack procedure operating in a black box setting against image-returning MRAG, a configuration in which the retrieved visual artifact is itself the response. Each query blends an attacker-held shadow image with an image already recovered from the system, and relevance-weighted resampling steers subsequent queries towards regions of the embedding space that still yield novel retrievals. Unlike current extraction attacks that aim to persuade the model towards data leakage by placing a malicious query as a textual prompt, embeds the malicious instructions inside a user-given input image. We evaluate on three plausible and distinct real-world scenarios: medical assistant, document-focused helper and general purpose tool. The experiments involve the study of the effectiveness of the attack on multiple CLIP-family retrievers, as well as the impact of various generators. A single 2500-query run reconstructs up to 611 distinct radiology images, 566 document scans and 416 general-purpose images under local-feature correspondence, and reaches up to 5.6× as many distinct datastore items as a non-adaptive baseline. Our results show the urgent need for safeguards specifically designed for multimodal data.
summaryZh: 本文提出了一种针对多模态检索增强生成（MRAG）系统的黑盒数据提取攻击方法。通过将恶意指令嵌入用户输入图像，攻击者可以诱导模型泄露检索库中的私有视觉数据。实验证明该方法在医疗和文档处理场景下具有极高的提取效率，凸显了多模态系统在知识检索环节的安全防护需求。

glossary.explanationZh: 结合多模态模型与外部知识库的检索增强生成技术。
模型将数据映射到的高维向量空间，用于计算语义相似度。
在无法获取模型内部参数或架构的情况下进行的攻击测试。
在多模态检索中被模型作为响应返回的图像或视觉内容。
